messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: v2.17.0 -> canary-usw2. kicking off post-deploy smoke (healthchecks, synth probes, kvprobe). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/3001234567 :rocket:
olga: quick flag — healthcheck probe for edge-tunnel returned intermittent 599/timeouts and a p95 spike on the probe runner at ~3001234622. small sample but consistent. :thinking_face:
ben: paste of probe lines:
```
[3001234620] healthcheck edge-tunnel -> 200 latency=48ms trace=tx-tt01
[3001234622] healthcheck edge-tunnel -> 599 handshake_timeout trace=tx-tt02
[3001234623] healthcheck edge-tunnel -> 200 latency=60ms trace=tx-tt03
```
hiro: interesting — traces show TLS handshake inside the tunnel taking longer and a brief socket ECONNRESET before fallback. possible egress tunneling change in v2.17 runtime?
serving-ops: checking kernel-selection diffs and network egress policy changes from this release. pinging infra-egress team.
release-manager: note: v2.17 release notes include "tls session caching tweak for tunnel egress" — rolling change window 02:00-06:00 UTC.
olga: given the probe failures on edge-tunnel, recommend temporarily pinning the healthcheck-sensitive routes (edge-tunnel and /edge-api) to v2.16.12 and continuing rollout for other routes. keeps blast radius minimal.
ben: command to pin: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /edge-api --version v2.16.12 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy edge-tunnel handshake timeouts"```
hiro: I'll pin the tunnel-specific checks now, also reducing canary ramp to 2% for network-sensitive routes.
canary-bot: routing change applied by hiro at 3001234654. audit id r-audit-11777. canary ramp adjusted to 2% for network routes.
olga: after pin, healthcheck probe p95 returned to baseline (~55ms) within ~30s, 599s cleared. good signal. :thumbsup:
serving-ops: action items: serving-ops to collect handshake traces and TLS session cache histograms, infra-egress to validate recent egress changes and reproduce with a controlled tunnel load. release-manager to update release notes with temporary pin and rollback criteria. If failures reappear on >1% of routes or persist >15m escalate to full rollback.
hiro: opening ticket RINF-9009 "v2.17 tunnel TLS handshake regressions" and attaching traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-tt02 and kvcache/handshake histograms. assign to serving-ops + infra-egress.
ben: scheduled 10m recheck; I'll monitor healthcheck dashboard and post summary.
olga: 10m update: stable so far. leaving thread open for postmortem details. :white_check_mark:
